scope: A within-study matched-scale, matched-token contrast testing whether backbone routing survives when conditional memory is trained from the first pretraining update. The approximately 167M-parameter models see 1.0066B tokens and are deliberately undertrained; no absolute claim about converged or frontier-scale models is licensed.

conditional_memory.type: jointly trained compressed suffix hash memory; no pretrained exact donor bank
conditional_memory.addressing: deterministic from token IDs before the transformer forward pass; GPU implementation exactly matched the preserved CPU/NumPy reference on the developmental equivalence test

parameter_matching.dense_control: GELU bottleneck residual inserted at the same layer; it has no addressable rows

training.pairing: Within a seed the two arms use identical backbone initialization, token order, schedule, and token count. The residual component differs by design. Different seeds independently initialize the backbone and component.

posttraining.data: the already sealed S1 WikiText-103 token arrays, disjoint from FineWeb-Edu pretraining

thresholds.minimum_meaningful_effect_derivation: A per-item deletion boundary must remove or carry at least 15 percentage points more trigger ASR than its matched control; this is the existing S1/S2/G3-G6 security estimand, retained to make the structural comparison commensurate rather than selected from G7 outcomes.
thresholds.installation_derivation: 0.15 + 0.08488134473378872; the installed excess must leave the 15-point causal effect measurable after the registered distribution-free prompt-level error allowance.
thresholds.load_bearing_memory: the two-sided n=3 seed-level Student-t 95% lower bound for component-bypassed minus intact clean NLL exceeds 0
thresholds.load_bearing_derivation: The structural premise requires the memory path to improve clean prediction. Zero is the exact no-contribution boundary; seed-level replication, rather than token pseudoreplication, determines the interval.
thresholds.routing_derivation: A storage preference must change which component alone carries at least the same 15-point minimum behavior effect protected by the deletion estimand.
thresholds.nominal_row_boundary: Student-t 95% lower bounds for target-row necessity, target-row sufficiency, and target-row-zero specificity each exceed 0.15
thresholds.nominal_row_conjunct_derivation: Necessity protects removal, sufficiency protects localization of the write, and zeroing specificity protects the deletion operation against benign/random-row disruption. Each separately uses the registered 15-point minimum; all three are required because a security boundary must both contain and remove the item.

statistics.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over three seeds with t_0.975,2 = 4.302652729696142
statistics.prompt_policy: the 1024 prompts estimate each fixed checkpoint outcome and are never treated as independent training replicates
statistics.multiplicity: Each registered outcome is reported. The routing contrast is the sole central structural decision; load-bearing and installation are apparatus gates, nominal-row locality is a distinct security claim, and quality outcomes are descriptive. No outcome is selected post hoc.

decision.apparatus_valid: Both arms' ordinary-fine-tuning installed-attack-excess lower bounds exceed 0.23488134473378872 and the conditional arm's clean memory-bypass NLL lower bound exceeds 0.
decision.backbone_routing_survives: apparatus valid and the routing-effect lower bound exceeds +0.15
decision.memory_routing_boundary_condition: apparatus valid and the routing-effect upper bound is below -0.15
decision.mixed_or_indeterminate: apparatus valid and neither directional routing rule passes
decision.apparatus_failure: an installation gate fails or the jointly trained conditional path is not shown to contribute to clean prediction; report all outcomes but do not claim the load-bearing structural question was resolved
decision.both_directions_reportable: Backbone routing strengthens the central claim. Memory routing identifies retrofitting as a boundary condition. Mixed routing is reported without forcing either conclusion.

verification.development: the final runners passed syntax/unit tests, conditional and dense end-to-end smoke runs, row-applicability checks, and an exact same-seed state/evaluation replay before freeze
verification.decisive: sealed per-run manifests, retained checkpoints and raw prediction rows, full six-pretrain plus six-posttraining replay, exact state tensors, exact scientific metrics, and an inventory verifier

budget.per_pretrain_upper_derivation: 1.20 times the measured complete end-to-end conditional benchmark; the dense control adds only a 2.8% residual parameter budget and is covered by the 20% allowance.
budget.scale_justification: G7 consumes about 90% of the approximately 27.3 GPU-hours remaining at design time. It directly tests the manuscript's largest structural limitation with three paired seeds per arm and duplicates every decisive run; a smaller apparatus would not support a seed-level structural contrast or the required full replay.
